source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
**Engagement Range** covers everything within 2" of a model horizontally and 5" vertically, measured per [Measuring Distances](vsdata:core-rule/measuring-distances) from the nearest point of its base, or of the model itself for a **[FRAME](vsdata:core-rule/frame)** model.

- A friendly model inside the Engagement Range of any enemy models is **engaged** with them, and so are all their units.
- A unit with no engaged models is **unengaged**.

frameModel.point: closest point of the model itself

engaged.trigger: a friendly model within Engagement Range of one or more enemy models
receiving: the units each of them belongs to
